name: New
overview: Scripture reveals that God initiates newness as a divine act, promising to do a new thing that brings transformation even in desolate places, as seen in Isaiah 43:19. This newness involves the renewing of the mind, enabling believers to discern and live out God's perfect will, according to Romans 12:2. Ultimately, Revelation 21:5 affirms God's sovereign authority to make all things new, underscoring the faithful fulfillment of His promises and the hope of complete restoration.
